goal: Avoid spamming node logs with periodic Tor connection warnings when Tor is not configured
Preserve warnings for users who enable Tor explicitly and log unexpected onion service disconnects
agreement: Strong support for eliminating log noise on default nodes
Verified by testing reduced log noise on macOS and Debian (pinheadmz, winterrdog)
Open suggestion to simplify the logging logic further (pinheadmz)
Addressed objection to ensure failures remain visible when Tor is explicitly configured (fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a regression that logged roughly 18 warnings an hour on default nodes
Silencing log spam is a modest quality-of-life fix that does not affect network behavior
